task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move the robot to BOX_TOP, pick it up, move to INSPECTION_TABLE, place it there temporarily. Then move back to BOX_MIDDLE, pick it up, move to INSPECTION_TABLE, place it there. Finally, move back to BOX_TOP's original position, pick it up again, and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack with only the middle box removed.
assumptions: The robot CAR starts at position (0, 0) approximately
BOX_TOP is at (2.0, -1.0) approximately and is the top of the stack
BOX_MIDDLE is at (2.0, -1.0) approximately and is under BOX_TOP
BOX_BOTTOM is at (2.0, -1.0) approximately and is the base
The robot can only pick the top box of a stack, so we must temporarily move BOX_TOP to access BOX_MIDDLE
After placing BOX_MIDDLE on INSPECTION_TABLE, we need to restore BOX_TOP onto BOX_BOTTOM
rtdl: def task MoveMiddleBoxToInspection(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="BOX_BOTTOM";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
